description.zh:
查询的物联网卡是否已销户，默认为否。

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether the queried IoT card has been canceled. Default value: false.

- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.

description.zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在[物联网SIM服务控制台](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的**卡管理页面**查看ICCID。
description.en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can find the ICCID on the IoT card, or view it on the **Card Management** page in the [IoT SIM Service console](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8).

description.zh:
物联网卡的实例ID。

只有查询的物联网卡已销户时（即**DestroyCard**为**true**）需要填入该参数。

您可以调用接口[ListCardInfo](~~425529~~)在返回参数中查看物联网卡的实例ID（VsimInstanceId）。
description.en:
The instance ID of the IoT card.

This parameter is required only when the queried IoT card has been canceled (i.e., **DestroyCard** is **true**).

You can call the [ListCardInfo](~~425529~~) API and view the instance ID (VsimInstanceId) of the IoT card in the response parameters.

description.zh:
是否展示子卡的详情信息，默认为否。

- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether to display the detail information of sub-cards. Default value: false.

- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明


单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Throttling


The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 20.

> RAM users share the Alibaba Cloud account quota.
